'''Demarchy''' was a political system that was used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>

The government of the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] homeworld [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]] was a [[Socialism|socialist]] demarchy led by the [[Tayan League]], a [[Politics/Legends|political]] party.<ref name="Strongholds" />
